reviewer: Claude (visual inspection of the contact sheets: views, forms, closeups, plus stats.json)
notes: v2 fixes D1, D3, D5, D7, D8 (verified in images). Collision hull now hidden in renders and lighting uniform.

defects.text: Handle is a heavy rectangular slab (42 mm deep, thick top bar) with square openings; a pressed-steel strap is thinner (about 30 mm) with taller grip openings.
defects.fix: Thin the handle to 30 mm deep, lower the top bar to 10 mm, make the openings taller.

defects.text: Large orange rust splashes on both broad faces and the sides read as a camouflage pattern, not wear; the texture is shared with other props and is baked.
defects.fix: Deferred: needs a purpose-made can paint texture (outside this loop test), flag to the user.

defects.text: Seam groove is not readable: on the top it shows as a faint dashed line, on the narrow ends it cannot be seen.
defects.fix: Add loops at y = +-5.5 mm before displacing, so the groove is a continuous V.

defects.text: Depth is 0.174 m against 0.165 +-0.008 m (the 4.5 mm ribs add to the 0.165 m body).
defects.fix: Body depth 0.156 m so that over the ribs it is 0.165 m.
